$comment: The scope object of spec §13j. Set by the field's experts, not by the agent and not by the owner. Versioned: a change here is a change to what the agent may work on.
principle: a known forward operator plus a learned prior; a measurement is invertible because the operator is known

set_by.$comment: roles, never names — naming a person in a design document commits them to something they have not agreed to. `named` is filled when a panel exists.

in.boundary: the imaging SYSTEM as the designed object — sensor choice, illumination, optics, timing and readout — co-designed with the reconstruction. Not the element alone: the pair that determines the result is the system and the method
the reconstruction problem only; the clinical endpoint is low-dose CT's or the clinician's
snapshot compressive imaging, including the mask convention this project measured
phase and coherent imaging under a known operator
computational capture where the operator is geometric or temporal
the inverse problem, not the instrument
deconvolution and aperture synthesis as an operator-plus-prior problem
element and aperture design within a system, evaluated in simulation and — with a body — fabricated

out.question: what is in a reconstructed scene
out.goes_to: the field that owns that question — low-dose CT for clinical CT, the user otherwise

out.question: semiconductor process and foundry engineering
out.why: it designs systems and selects sensors; it does not develop the processes that make them

out.question: clinical endpoints
out.why: image quality is not diagnostic performance
out.goes_to: low-dose CT §16, or the relevant clinical field

adjacent.relation: shares operator-plus-prior; owns the clinical endpoint
an imaging problem this agent does not own

claims_allowed: reconstruction quality under a stated operator and metric
transfer between subfields when measured on real data
claims_forbidden: any claim about a named individual
any statement that a result is clinically actionable without the endpoint role's sign-off
would_move_the_boundary: rung 5 failing — if transfer is superficial, this is not one field and the scope contracts to the subfields that do share the structure
$watch_comment: if this rung stays blocked by a dependency the scope put out of bounds, the boundary is in the wrong place (§13j)
$revision: v2: hardware system design admitted. The field's rung 6 was already about the element-and-method PAIR; the object that determines a result is the whole system, so the scope now says so and the foundry boundary is stated more precisely than 'sensor process engineering' did.
$agent_id_comment: the page is `computational-imaging` and the code is `imaging` — research_agents.registry.NAMES and the registry row. The names differ, so the join has to be written down.
